input_asset_sanity.purpose: Confirm the P0 asset would in fact exercise HaMeR once unblocked (egocentric human hands must be present in-frame).
input_asset_sanity.observation: Single 1280x720 ego-centric frame shows two clearly visible human hands (left and right) grasping a tissue box on a desk; wrists and most fingers in frame, unobstructed.
input_asset_sanity.note: This sanity check is qualitative and does NOT substitute for the smoke 6 acceptance criteria; no HaMeR inference was run.

mano_params_non_empty.threshold: betas.shape[0] > 0 and poses.shape[0] > 0 and trans.shape[0] > 0 for both hands

mano_params_all_finite.threshold: torch.isfinite(params).all() == True for betas, poses, trans

keypoint_confidence_above_threshold.threshold: median 2D keypoint confidence over f_0001..f_0030 >= 0.20 (threshold to be fixed in the test before GREEN, not after)

reprojection_error_recorded.threshold: mean reprojection error (3D MANO joints projected vs HaMeR 2D keypoints) < 15 px; recorded into report regardless of pass/fail

left_right_consistency.threshold: both hands detected in >= 80% of the 30 frames; handedness flip count <= 2

mps_primary_inference.threshold: dominant inference device == 'mps'; any op-level CPU fallback enumerated explicitly in cpu_fallback_ops

mps_evidence.note: torch 2.9.1 reports torch.backends.mps.is_available() == True on this machine, but no HaMeR inference was executed, so no runtime MPS occupancy evidence exists for this smoke.
